questions: Must an allowed OPTIONS preflight end immediately with the 204 response, or must it continue to the body-size check because it was not refused?

quotes: each check either produces the response named for it and ends the request there, or leaves the request untouched for the next check to evaluate.

answer an OPTIONS request carrying an Origin listed in settings.allowed_origins with a 204 preflight echoing the requested method and headers plus Vary Origin, together with the allow-origin and allow-credentials headers every allowed-origin response carries, and reject an unlisted origin with 403;
judgement.why: The allowed preflight produces the named 204 response and therefore ends the request at that check.

topics.topic: Whether canonical paths or log lines take precedence when path length is unbounded
questions: Must the canonical path be truncated or otherwise bounded, breaking the required field value, or must the complete potentially unbounded canonical path be emitted, breaking the bounded-line requirement?

quotes: MUST build one bounded line of exactly four labelled fields in this order and shape, so an operator log parser does not change between builds: 'rid=<request id> method=<method> path=<canonical path without query string> status=<status>'.

It MUST classify every path through _canonical_path so a deployment-prefixed path is treated exactly like its stripped inner path, keep its rate-limit state bounded inside the installed guard, and MUST NOT authenticate a principal, read persistence, import a domain or application module, or import starlette directly.
judgement.why: The required bounded log line conflicts with emitting the canonical path in the exact prescribed field shape when that path has no stated length bound.
